decisions.reason: Marketplace whitelisting and royalty enforcement do not change which NFT-associated book access, referral code, badges, or prize tickets transfer to a secondary buyer.
The token-standard change does not change deployment from the Base network or its Ethereum L2 classification.
Using ERC-721C does not change the NFT ebook asset type, unlimited supply model, mint price, or mint-number identifier represented by this Requirement.
The existing FAQ statement that secondary sales carry a visible flat $10 royalty remains valid, and the source does not require the FAQ to describe ERC-721C or marketplace whitelisting.
The royalty-enforcement mechanism does not alter the Small Block amount, cadence, eligibility, qualifying sale types, or rule that secondary royalties fund the pool.
The secondary-sale token standard does not change fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, access, or reward-holding behavior.
The current About-page content does not assert a standard ERC-721 token, and the source contains no instruction to revise the page with ERC-721C details.
The ownership-gating rule explicitly names Base ERC-721 ownership, so replacing standard ERC-721 with ERC-721C necessarily changes the token ownership that Lit Protocol must verify.
